page_title: Udio | AI Music Generator - Official Website

sources.entry: Udio - An AI-powered platform designed to simplify and innovate audio editing and production, making high-quality audio accessible to everyone.

summary.name: Udio
summary.one_liner: Udio is an AI music generator where you describe a song in text and it creates the track, with tools for uploading and editing your own audio and sharing music with a community.
use_cases: Creating a custom song from a text description
Making background music such as lo-fi for meditation
Writing a personalized song for a special occasion
Editing or extending uploaded audio with AI tools
Sharing and discovering music in a creator community
summary.what_it_does: Udio lets users create songs by describing them in text, such as a ballad for a date or a lo-fi track for meditation. Users can upload their own audio and use what the page calls state-of-the-art AI editing tools. Finished tracks can be published on the platform for others to listen to. The site also offers following artists and browsing a feed of community-made songs. The page presents the tool as usable by both professional musicians and amateurs.
notable: Generates full songs from plain-text descriptions
AI editing tools for user-uploaded audio
Built-in community for publishing and following creators
caveats: Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
